behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing in Find a person narrows the Assignee options.
behaviors.combine-filters: Selecting Priya while the Done status filter is active shows only her Done task.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.empty-assignee: Selecting Ana shows “Nothing assigned to Ana yet” with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clicking Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone and shows the full task list.

history.notes: The locators scope options to the Assignee listbox and use the seed data’s task counts. The status filter is scoped to the toolbar so card status controls cannot match it.
